title: Affine variational functionals, isoperimetric problems and stability
summary: We study three affine variational quantities built on the affine $L^p$ energy of Lutwak, Yang and Zhang: the affine Poincaré--Sobolev constants $Λ^{\mathcal{A}}_{p,q}(Ω)$ of a bounded open set, the associated affine torsional rigidity, and the affine $p$-capacity of a compact set. We show that ellipsoids are the only extremal sets in their corresponding isoperimetric inequalities, and that the affine capacity of a compact set of positive volume is attained by a potential solving the affine $p$-Laplace equation.
